summary.text: Bryan McCarty of Worland, a Democrat, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Secretary of State of Wyoming to Robert Short.
He describes a private-sector career, mostly in the railroad industry, with internal audit and Six Sigma training.

paragraphs.text: Bryan McCarty was born in Mansfield, Ohio, and now lives in Worland, where he has lived for six years and in Wyoming for seven.
He says he has had strong ties to Wyoming since childhood.
McCarty describes a private-sector career mostly in the railroad industry, largely with large corporations, and cites training in internal audit and Six Sigma in a regulatory-compliance culture.
He advanced from the August 18, 2026 Democratic primary with 97.3 percent of the vote.

McCarty said the Secretary of State's role was to administer existing election rules rather than advocate changes, which he said would be a conflict of interest, and that he would use his internal audit experience to vet business registrations.
During the campaign, he said he would use the office's seat on the State Board of Land Commissioners to keep public lands in public hands.
He received 23.8% of the vote to Robert Short's 67.8%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
